meta.name: workcell-verify
meta.description: workcell verification run: the repository's configured verification commands, with a writable checkout so a build can write its target directory, network denied, no harness configuration or credentials, no keychain, and read-only package caches. The checkout is already agent-written; the purpose of this profile is that a verification command cannot reach the network or the operator's credentials. A deployment whose verification genuinely needs a network host adds it to this profile deliberately (a reviewed change), never through a runtime switch.
